family_reports.body: Traumatized the children, destroyed their childhoods and bankrupt me all in the name of greed.
Lexington County Family Court has ruined my opportunity to be a mother to my children. This is why I am a strong supporter of 50/50 parenting time/custody post divorce.

Permanent irreparable damage to my kids- homelessness three times, constant terror, bankruptcy two times, unspeakable horrors and losses. The abuser called all the shots and those of us that tried to advocate for the child- mom, therapist and child themselves- all lost everything and were discredited. Hold them accountable

The South Carolina Family Court system failed my children and destroyed my motherhood. Until we have more court actors trained in Coercive Control and Domestic Violence children and families will suffer.

public_comments.comment_text: Judge Seigler gave my ex husband primary custody of young children from exes first and second wife. Both wives were the primary parent during the marriage. Once dad was finished with each marriage he was all of a sudden interested in parenting by filing “Emergency Motions” and stating the mother’s were “unfit.” Gave my ex husband primary custody of our two daughters who were 3 and 7 when I had always been their primary caregiver. He also gave my ex husband primary custody of his two older daughters when their mother had always been the primary caregiver. I raised his older daughters because my ex husband alienated his older daughters from their mother. Judge Seigler is not trained in Domestic Violence or Coercive Control.
